### @robbiebyrd - 2026-08-04T15:06:15Z

Hi Tanner! I will take a look at this; I think it is a quirk of Microsoft Edge, but should be an easy fix. Thank you for reporting!

### @robbiebyrd - 2026-08-04T15:21:27Z

Oh, and for your question about resetting the session: I have added this. There are a few places to accomplish this; in the Accounts app, you can erase your chat session to rest your chats with buddies. To reset most everything else, double clicking the Trash Can icon will remove the current settings and give you a fresh desktop.
